levels.name: Red
levels.title: Words and boxes
levels.description: Print things, store things in boxes (variables), and make your first decisions.

levels.name: Orange
levels.title: Lists and loops
levels.description: Work with collections of things and repeat work without repeating yourself.

interviewPack.solveIt: One timed Solve-It on arrays or hash maps
interviewPack.star: STAR prompt: a bug you tracked down

levels.rebuild: Array helpers (map, filter, reduce written by hand)

levels.name: Yellow
levels.title: Tiny tools
levels.description: The everyday tools of a working developer: async code, Git, the terminal, tests and types.

interviewPack.sayIt: Say-It questions on async, Git and testing
interviewPack.star: STAR prompt: a code review disagreement

levels.name: Green
levels.title: Web pages
levels.description: Build real pages: structure, style, behavior, and keeping them fast, safe and accessible.
strikes: Browser rendering and Core Web Vitals

interviewPack.sayIt: Say-It questions on the DOM, CSS layout and accessibility
interviewPack.solveIt: One timed Solve-It on the DOM
interviewPack.star: STAR prompt: improving an experience for users

levels.name: Blue
levels.title: Servers and data
levels.description: APIs, databases, auth and security. Runs on a local-only server runner (Phase 3).
levels.runner: local server runner (local only, with warnings)
strikes: Middleware: build your own use()/next() chain (browser-runnable)
Middleware: CORS and rate limiting by hand

interviewPack.sayIt: Say-It questions on HTTP, REST, SQL and auth
interviewPack.solveIt: One timed Solve-It: build a small middleware chain

levels.name: Indigo
levels.title: React
levels.description: Components, state and the tools around them, up to Next.js and a design system.
strikes: Next.js: server components and route handlers

interviewPack.sayIt: Say-It questions on state, effects and rendering
interviewPack.solveIt: One timed Solve-It: a small component with state

levels.name: Violet
levels.title: Cloud
levels.description: Ship it: containers, pipelines and AWS. Guided, local first, AWS free plan only, with cost-trap warnings and tear-down steps.
strikes: CI/CD with GitHub Actions (lint, test, build, deploy)
Linux server basics and Nginx reverse proxy
AWS: CloudWatch logs, metrics and alarms
API Gateway authorizers vs Express middleware

interviewPack.sayIt: Say-It questions on containers, CI/CD and IAM
interviewPack.solveIt: One timed Solve-It: design a deploy pipeline on paper
interviewPack.star: STAR prompt: a deploy that went wrong

levels.title: AI and capstone
levels.description: Local AI with Ollama only, system design, and a browser-only Hexhammer as the capstone.
strikes: System design: scalability and load balancing
System design: caching layers and CDN
System design: queues and rate limiter
Capstone: deploy a browser-only version of Hexhammer

interviewPack.sayIt: Say-It questions on RAG, agents and system design
interviewPack.star: STAR prompt: a big decision with tradeoffs
